description: We are 9th-grade students at Oxbridge International School, from Uzbekistan, Tashkent city. We have a keen interest in astrophysics and want to create projects that are both imaginative and beneficial to the public. Our team consists of six members, all fully committed to working on this initiative:)
summary:
We are a group of students from Oxbridge International School in Tashkent. The goal of our project is to help people learn about science (NASA EIC visualizations of Earth) through music and to create a universal, free, and accessible product that can help achieve this.

Our team is very interested in this project because we want to popularize science in its various forms. We want to show people how Earth can be experienced without the ability to see, especically for blind people.

The main tools we use are sounds and colors within one specific project. The main idea is sonification. We show how sound and color can be combined to describe planets and stars for visually impaired and blind people who cannot see everything that we can.

To do this, we take numerical data about the image of the Earth and transform it into sound. To create this, we use seismic data, atmospheric and climate data, and sea level measurements.

We communicate these indicators through pitch, volume, timbre, and tempo.
details:
Our project is a new way to explore and understand Earth through music, sound, and interactive maps. We turn scientific information about our planet into music, allowing people to discover nature through their sense of hearing.

Our website uses different types of Earth data to create unique melodies for different regions of the planet. You can explore a 3D globe, discover different landscapes and biomes, and see how temperature and rainfall change across the world. Each region has its own sound based on its natural conditions.

We use 10 different Earth parameters to create music. These data are transformed into sounds with different pitches, rhythms, volumes, and tones. This means that every place on Earth can have its own musical identity.

You can choose a region, listen to its unique melody, and even create your own observation points on the globe. Our website also allows you to upload your own music and find a place on Earth with similar sound characteristics. You can explore different musical styles and compare how different parts of our planet sound.

We believe that music can be more than just entertainment. It can help us understand scientific information, discover connections in nature, and see our planet from a completely different perspective.

One of our main goals is to make science more accessible, especially for blind and visually impaired people. We want everyone to have the opportunity to explore Earth, regardless of their ability to see.

Our project brings together science, technology, and creativity to show that every part of our planet has its own story — and every story has a sound.
